01运行前的观察目标02用二维条件训练一维增量动作策略03代码说明

运行前先预测关键输出，再对照断言和下方代码说明。核对通过后，尝试只改变一个输入或配置，解释输出为什么变化。

运行前的观察目标

输出动作形状 (256, 1)、训练前后的 MSE 和一条一维合成轨迹。固定种子便于复查，数值会受运行库影响；该示例不是完整机器人策略。

python 27_behavior-cloning_demo.py环境配置

用二维条件训练一维增量动作策略

27_behavior-cloning_demo.py
import torchfrom torch import nn torch.manual_seed(7)torch.set_num_threads(1) # STEP 1: 构造合成示教，条件是 [当前位置, 目标位置]condition = torch.rand(256, 2) * 2 - 1expert_action = (0.4 * (condition[:, 1:] - condition[:, :1])).clamp(-0.2, 0.2)policy = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2, 32), nn.Tanh(), nn.Linear(32, 1))optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW(policy.parameters(), lr=0.01, weight_decay=0.0)with torch.no_grad():    initial_loss = (policy(condition) - expert_action).square().mean().item() # STEP 2: 在固定示教上学习条件动作映射for _ in range(200):    prediction = policy(condition)  # [256, 1]    loss = (prediction - expert_action).square().mean()    optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)    loss.backward()    optimizer.step() # STEP 3: 让预测动作影响下一步输入，构成闭环policy.eval()position, goal = -0.8, 0.7trajectory = [position]with torch.no_grad():    for _ in range(15):        inputs = torch.tensor([[position, goal]])        action = policy(inputs).clamp(-0.2, 0.2).item()        position += action  # 这里只是合成的一维积分系统        trajectory.append(position)    final_loss = (policy(condition) - expert_action).square().mean().item() # STEP 4: 分开报告拟合误差与这一条合成轨迹print('prediction shape:', tuple(policy(condition).shape))print('training MSE:', round(initial_loss, 6), '->', round(final_loss, 6))print('rollout positions:', [round(p, 3) for p in trajectory])print('final goal error:', round(abs(position - goal), 4))assert torch.isfinite(torch.tensor(trajectory)).all()
